paper_title: Значение на секторните политики за растежа на българската икономика
caption: Растеж на БВП и инвестициите, при база 2007 година
model_annotation:
The chart illustrates the changes in GDP and investments over a period of time, comparing the growth of these economic indicators. The X-axis is labeled with years from 2007 to 2018, with a linear scale and evenly spaced labels at every year. The Y-axis is labeled with values ranging from 40 to 140, with a linear scale and labels at intervals of 20 units. 

The blue line, representing GDP, starts at 100 in 2007 and ends at approximately 123 in 2018, showing a general upward trend with some fluctuations. It has a diamond marker and a solid line style. 

The red line, representing private investments, begins at around 100 in 2007, peaks at about 125 in 2008, and then declines to roughly 70 in 2014 before rising again to approximately 95 in 2018. It is marked with a square marker and a solid line style. 

The green line, representing public investments, starts at 100 in 2007, peaks at around 115 in 2009, drops to about 70 in 2012, and then surges to nearly 140 in 2015 before falling to roughly 55 in 2017 and rising again to approximately 90 in 2018. It is marked with a triangle marker and a solid line style. 

Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of the changes in GDP and investments over the specified period, allowing for a comparison of their growth patterns.
